steps.content: Having vented her feelings, Sallie manages to calm down somewhat.
Security on this ship is airtight. Every gate requires a keycard with the right clearance. A dancer like her can't even leave this deck, let alone the ship.
Sallie can't find a way to escape, and there's no one she can ask. She doesn't trust a soul on this vessel.

The ship is a prison of steel and iron. She wants to search for another way, but time is running out. Before the next performance, whether she likes it or not, the dancers will be brought out to entertain the distinguished guests.
